info.title: Rockey Hospitality API
info.description: Frozen 51-operation business contract. Documentation requires ADMIN. USER: own registrations; STAFF: authorized identity/Department scope; ADMIN: operational oversight. See the canonical API contract for lifecycle, validation and scope rules.

get.description: Access: Assigned STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/tasks/{taskId}.
Access: STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/rooms/{roomId}.
Access: STAFF scoped, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/inventory/{itemId}.
Access: USER, STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/events/{eventId}.

delete.summary: Cancel eligible event without hard deletion

get.description: Access: ADMIN; self STAFF. Canonical operation: GET /api/employees/{employeeId}.
Access: STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/departments/{departmentId}.

put.description: Access: Recipient STAFF; ADMIN for own alert. Canonical operation: PUT /api/alerts/{alertId}/read.

get.description: Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/tasks.
Access: STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/rooms.
Access: STAFF scoped, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/inventory.
Access: USER, STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/events.
Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/employees.

post.summary: Create employee and optional linked login

get.description: Access: STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/departments.

post.description: Access: Public, rate limited. Canonical operation: POST /api/auth/register.
Access: Refresh token. Canonical operation: POST /api/auth/refresh.

post.summary: Revoke current refresh session and expire refresh cookie
post.description: Access: USER, STAFF, ADMIN; access token required. Canonical operation: POST /api/auth/logout.
Access: Public, rate limited. Canonical operation: POST /api/auth/login.

patch.description: Access: Assigned STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: PATCH /api/tasks/{taskId}/complete.
Access: STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: PATCH /api/rooms/{roomId}/status.

get.description: Access: Self STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/tasks/assigned/{employeeId}.
Access: USER. Canonical operation: GET /api/events/registrations/me.
Access: USER, STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/auth/me.
Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/analytics/tasks.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Positive Department ID; unknown ID returns zero counts.

get.description: Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/analytics/rooms.

parameters.name: floor
parameters.description: Optional floor, 1–99; omitted includes all floors.

get.summary: Inventory thresholds and global event registration/preparation
get.description: Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/analytics/inventory-events.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Positive Department ID filters Inventory only; Events remain global. No date filters.

get.description: Access: ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/analytics/departments.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Optional positive Department ID; unknown ID returns 404.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page; fixed Department ID ascending order.

get.description: Access: USER, STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/analytics/dashboard.
Access: STAFF own, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/alerts.
Access: Recipient STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: GET /api/alerts/{alertId}.

delete.description: Access: Recipient STAFF, ADMIN. Canonical operation: DELETE /api/alerts/{alertId}.
